plan.tagline: Raw Pavement, Pure Carnage, Zero Commerce
plan.heroTitle: NO SPONSORS. NO MERCH. PURE STREET CHAOS.
plan.heroSub: An unadulterated visual archive celebrating underground rippers, blood-stained curbs, and handrail savagery—curated with animated monster doodle graphics, gritty zine typography, and high-octane street reels.
plan.targetAudience: Skateboarders, DIY street filmers, and core skate culture purists

faq.q: Are you really not selling boards, clothes, or stickers?
faq.a: Zero products, zero shopping carts. Hellhound Skate Collective exists purely as a monument to raw skateboarding, independent filmmakers, and the skaters destroying the streets.

faq.q: Do I need to register an account or give an email to watch the video parts?
faq.a: Never. No accounts, no email newsletters, and no passwords. Click any skater reel and watch immediately with zero friction.

faq.q: How do independent skaters get featured on the showcase?
faq.a: Curation is strictly community and footage driven. Street skaters and DIY filmers send raw tapes directly—no corporate sponsor backing required.
